messages:
Anya (Product): quick sync — we need to decide which dedicated-capacity items land in Q2. scope: reserved pools, soft-burst, quota visibility, autoscale gating.
Matt (Eng): can we list dependencies? e.g., quota visibility depends on telemetry + console work
Sofia (Customer Success): > Customer ask: ACME wants guaranteed burst for checkout flows — they need 99th p99 latency for 500 concurrent sessions during peak
Carla (Sales): ACME is willing to pay for reserved prewarm if we can guarantee the burst window. they asked for SLA language.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): technical constraints: prewarm+burst needs prealloc + eviction policy. autoscale gating requires control-plane flags and per-tenant admission.
Matt (Eng): rough estimate: prewarm infra + fallback path ~2 sprints, autoscale gating + policies ~3 sprints if we do parallel work
Anya (Product): decision tradeoffs: ship smaller first (quota visibility + simple burst credits) vs wait for full autoscale gating. thoughts?
Sofia (Customer Success): Customers prefer predictability. If we release quota dashboard and manual burst credits, ACME will accept interim solution
Carla (Sales): propose selling interim as 'Burst Assurance Pilot' — include capacity hold and invoice line item
Ravi (Eng-Platform): risk: interim manual credits complicates billing. need clear owner for rev rec and ops alerts. Who owns runbook?
Matt (Eng): ops runbook: `on-call -> allocate credits -> monitor p99 -> escalate`. Could be templated in 1 week if we prioritize.
Anya (Product): Launch criteria proposal:
- telemetry: token-level occupancy + pool saturation alerts
- console: tenant quota visibility
- ops: runbook + one runbook drill
- SLA: contract addendum for pilot customers
Agree or modify?
Carla (Sales): add: pricing delta for reserved prewarm + 30 day notice for burst window changes
Sofia (Customer Success): + confirm ACME is OK with manual allocation for pilot before full autoscale
Matt (Eng): technical note: quantify prewarm cost: estimate 10% capacity overhead for 2h/day peak -> cost model needed
Anya (Product): next steps: Matt/Ravi to scope infra tickets + cost estimate by EOD Friday. Carla/Sofia to get ACME verbal ok and draft pilot SLA. I'll consolidate and propose milestone dates.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): `deploy-bot: created ticket INF-2147` 
deploy-bot: INF-2147 created by Ravi — prewarm capacity prototype
Anya (Product): thanks team — dropping outcomes into roadmap doc after we have estimates. We'll sync Tue 10am to finalize acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
